description: In a world full of approximations, we live to make these approximations closer to exact. We have members who are multi-talented and have web-development experiences. Our project is centered in Forecasting the future events by analyzing the past. "Learn from your mistakes" and "History repeats itself" are our slagons. Yeah, Linearization-by finding cases happened in different timelines–or in our case by analyzing different problems and their causes in our atmosphere, we can predict the future!
